steps.content:
"Lieutenant": The enemy is secretly transporting supplies to reinforce their front lines. Their so-called ceasefire is nothing but a facade.
"Lieutenant": Our sabotage efforts have had some effect, but without pinpointing their supply routes, we cannot truly cripple the enemy.
"Lieutenant": But please make no mistake. We will not waver. Every Broken Blade squad fights with one purpose: victory.
"Lieutenant": As for the battlefields beyond our reach, you may need to contact the FAC first. Some matters still require their involvement.
The man nicknamed "Lieutenant" lives up to his reputation. Even through the battle report, you can almost hear his low, calm voice—devoid of emotion, yet resolute.
